// Scratch only (CHAOS-12417): ask-dev's served-word fixtures, from ACR's real encoder at the pin.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"github.com/full-chaos/dev-health-acr/internal/contextfabric"
	contractsv1 "github.com/full-chaos/dev-health-acr/internal/contracts/v1"
)

const maxBytes = 65536

func load(name string) contextfabric.InvestigationResult {
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join("contracts/examples/v1", name))
	must(err)
	var result contextfabric.InvestigationResult
	must(json.Unmarshal(raw, &result))
	return result
}

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

func row(requirement, obligation string, outcome contractsv1.ContextFabricPlanRequirementOutcome, served, declared int) contextfabric.RequirementOutcomeRow {
	return contextfabric.RequirementOutcomeRow{
		Stage: contractsv1.ContextFabricOutcomeStageAssembledResult, Requirement: requirement, Obligation: obligation,
		Outcome: outcome, Impact: impact(outcome), Served: served, Declared: declared,
	}
}

func impact(outcome contractsv1.ContextFabricPlanRequirementOutcome) contractsv1.ContextFabricAnswerImpactKind {
	if outcome == contractsv1.ContextFabricRequirementSatisfied {
		return contractsv1.ContextFabricAnswerImpactNone
	}
	return contractsv1.ContextFabricAnswerImpactDepth
}

func withRows(result contextfabric.InvestigationResult, rows ...contextfabric.RequirementOutcomeRow) contextfabric.InvestigationResult {
	result.Completeness.Outcomes = append(result.Completeness.Outcomes, rows...)
	result.Completeness = contextfabric.ComputeAnswerCompleteness(result)
	return result
}

func main() {
	out := os.Args[1]
	shapes := "context_fabric_investigation_result_render_shapes.v1.json"
	satisfied := contractsv1.ContextFabricRequirementSatisfied
	narrowed := contractsv1.ContextFabricRequirementNarrowed
	unavailable := contractsv1.ContextFabricRequirementUnavailable

	full := withRows(load(shapes), row("state/subject/team", "state", satisfied, 1, 1), row("health/subject/team", "health", satisfied, 1, 1))
	notFullyCovered := withRows(load(shapes), row("health/subject/team", "health", narrowed, 1, 2))
	notFullyCovered.Status = contractsv1.ContextFabricInvestigationComplete
	notFullyCovered.Completeness = contextfabric.ComputeAnswerCompleteness(notFullyCovered)

	corrected := withRows(load(shapes), row("health/subject/team", "health", narrowed, 1, 2))
	corrected = contextfabric.ApplyServerCompletenessAuthority(corrected, true, true, contextfabric.DeriveCompletenessAuthority(corrected))

	degraded := load(shapes)
	degraded.Status = contractsv1.ContextFabricInvestigationDegraded
	degraded = withRows(degraded, row("evidence/subject/team", "evidence", unavailable, 0, 1))

	noMatch := load("context_fabric_investigation_result.v1.json")
	noMatch.Status = contractsv1.ContextFabricInvestigationNoMatch
	noMatch.Completeness = contextfabric.ComputeAnswerCompleteness(noMatch)

	// Every served vocabulary in one result, on the fields the design's table names.
	every := withRows(load(shapes), row("health/subject/repository", "health", narrowed, 1, 2))
	every.Cohort.Kind = "repository"
	for index := range every.Cohort.Members {
		member := &every.Cohort.Members[index]
		member.Subject.Kind = "repository"
		for driver := range member.Drivers {
			if member.Drivers[driver].Signal == "investment_mix" {
				member.Drivers[driver].Window = contractsv1.ContextFabricCohortMemberDriverWindowCurrentVsPrior
				member.Drivers[driver].ThresholdLabels = []string{"investment_mix.reactive_share_high"}
			}
		}
	}
	every.Cohort.Members[0].Outcome = contractsv1.ContextFabricCohortOutcomeProvisional
	every.Cohort.Members[0].MissingSignals = []string{"workload.forecast_pressure"}
	every.EffectiveEvidenceWindow = &contractsv1.ContextFabricEffectiveEvidenceWindow{
		RelativeID: contractsv1.ContextFabricRelativeWindowTrailing30D,
		Provenance: contractsv1.ContextFabricWindowQuestionStated,
	}
	every.SubjectResolution.PriorSubjectReceiptDispositions = []contractsv1.ContextFabricPriorSubjectReceiptEntry{{
		PriorResultID: "result_prior_00000001", ReceiptID: "sbjr_prior_00000001",
		Disposition: contractsv1.ContextFabricPriorSubjectReceiptSkippedStaleGraphEpoch,
	}}
	base := every.Coverage.Sources[0]
	every.Coverage.Sources = nil
	for _, state := range []string{"available", "stale", "unavailable", "no_data", "not_applicable"} {
		source := base
		source.State = contractsv1.ContextFabricSourceState(state)
		every.Coverage.Sources = append(every.Coverage.Sources, source)
	}

	cases := map[string]contextfabric.InvestigationResult{
		"every-vocabulary":  every,
		"full-answer":       full,
		"plain-answer":      load(shapes),
		"not-fully-covered": notFullyCovered,
		"corrected":         corrected,
		"degraded":          degraded,
		"no-match":          noMatch,
		"clarification":     load("context_fabric_investigation_result.v2.json"),
	}
	for name, result := range cases {
		served, tier := contextfabric.ServeVocabularyLabels(result, true, maxBytes)
		encoded, err := json.Marshal(served)
		must(err)
		must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, name+".json"), encoded, 0o644))
		fmt.Printf("%-22s status=%-24s state=%-12s tier=%-12s labels=%d bytes=%d\n", name, served.Status, served.Completeness.State, tier, len(served.VocabularyLabels), len(encoded))
	}
}
